input.content:
# Quarterly operations report — May–July 2026

## Summary

The quarter was financially solid but showed a softening trend as it closed.
Revenue totalled €1,233,225 against costs of €467,640, for a net of €765,585
— a 62.1% margin. May and June grew steadily (June revenue up 4.6% on May),
but July reversed that momentum with a 9.6% revenue decline. Customer growth
remained positive at 153 net adds over the quarter, though both sign-ups and
churn moved in the wrong direction month over month. Support kept pace with
demand, closing 95.5% of tickets opened.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | 4.6% |
| July revenue growth | -9.6% |

## Notes

Worth flagging upward: July's revenue dropped 9.6% after two months of
growth, and the customer engine cooled through the quarter — new sign-ups
fell from 86 (May) to 74 (June) to 63 (July) while churn rose from 17 to 22
to 31. Costs stayed flat and controlled (€151,120 → €158,240 → €158,280), so
the margin story remains healthy. On the positive side, support closed out
the quarter strongly, with July's close rate the best of the three months
(291 of 298 tickets closed).
